name: Camera obscura / the inspectable object
art: The camera model is original procedural geometry in the cited source. Reuse compatible source or create a comparably detailed model. The reference author's component counts are not acceptance targets or verified facts about this model.

properties.label: Camera inspection workbench
properties.text: Balance a large inspectable camera on a pale technical studio with a compact top-left statement, narrow right specimen column and bottom inspection strip. Reserve ample object area, a visible grounding shadow and spare technical annotations.

properties.label: Layered mechanical camera assembly
properties.text: Model coherent lens, body and internal subassemblies with concentric barrel lips, knurling, fasteners, top dials, circuitry, iris leaves and registered lens layers. Contact interfaces and edge bevels make the relationships plausible; raw part count is not the quality target.

properties.label: Graphite, metal and green optics
properties.text: Use a graphite body, silver and warm-metal rings, fine grip texture, translucent green-tinted optics and engraved-looking labels. Distinguish rough body surfaces, metal edges and transmissive glass.

properties.label: Assembled, exploded and inside views
properties.text: Assembled, Exploded and Inside expose real configurations. One separation scalar moves coherent subassemblies along the lens/body axis, while restrained pointer motion changes the inspection angle without losing registration.

properties.label: Instanced Three.js construction
properties.text: The showcase renderer is Three.js with instanced repeated details and physical materials. The source author's stated component counts are unverified and are not requirements.

properties.label: Mechanical configuration integrity
properties.text: Inspect all three configurations at maximum separation. Reject detached labels, intersecting iris leaves, ungrounded parts or portrait clipping.

properties.label: Selected camera fallback
properties.text: Controls must expose real changes and every fallback must preserve the selected configuration.
